VlocityDataPackData.Name: LoanEligibilityIP
VlocityDataPackData.Description: Orchestrates the full loan eligibility decisioning pipeline: input validation, DTI calculation, credit score fetch, eligibility decision via WealthManagementCallable, LoanApplication__c upsert via DataRaptor, and approval routing. Supports two action modes: CALCULATE_DTI (Step 2 autoTrigger) and FULL_ELIGIBILITY (Step 3 Submit).

Elements.name: InitializeContext
Elements.description: Set correlation ID, determine action mode (CALCULATE_DTI vs FULL_ELIGIBILITY), and initialize output variables.

Elements.name: ValidateInputs
Elements.description: Validate that required loan inputs are present and within acceptable ranges. Surface validation errors immediately rather than failing mid-pipeline.

validations.errorMessage: Annual income must be greater than zero.
Monthly debt payments cannot be negative.
Requested loan amount must be greater than zero.
Applicant ID is required for full eligibility check.

Elements.name: CalculateDTI
Elements.description: Calls WealthManagementCallable.call('calcDebtToIncomeRatio') to compute the debt-to-income ratio. Pure calculation — no DML, no callout. Safe to run in both CALCULATE_DTI and FULL_ELIGIBILITY modes.

Elements.name: ClassifyDti
Elements.description: Categorizes the DTI into LOW / MODERATE / HIGH for OmniScript warning display and downstream branching.

assignments.name: dtiMessage
assignments.value: %dti% <= 36 ? 'Excellent — well within guidelines.' : (%dti% <= 50 ? 'Acceptable — manual review may apply.' : 'High — application likely requires manual review or may be declined.')

Elements.name: EarlyExitForDTIOnlyMode
Elements.description: If actionMode is CALCULATE_DTI (called from OmniScript Step 2 autoTrigger), return DTI result immediately without running credit check or DR Load. Saves callout quota and avoids premature credit pull.

Elements.name: FetchCreditScore
Elements.description: Calls WealthManagementCallable.call('fetchCreditScore') → CreditScoreService.fetchScore(). Named Credential CreditBureauNC is resolved inside the Callable. Makes one HTTP callout via Salesforce callout framework.

onError.comment: Credit API failure should not block loan application creation — decision becomes MANUAL_REVIEW when score is unavailable

Elements.name: SetCreditContext
Elements.description: Move credit score from ApexAction output into IP-level context variables for downstream use.

Elements.name: RunEligibilityDecision
Elements.description: Calls WealthManagementCallable.call('calculateLoanEligibility'). This invokes LoanEligibilityService.scoreEligibility() which uses cached credit score + DTI to produce AUTO_APPROVED / MANUAL_REVIEW / DECLINED. Note: at this point the LoanApplication__c record may not exist yet — the service will create it if loanAppId is null, or update it if provided.

onError.comment: Decision engine failure defaults to MANUAL_REVIEW so application is not silently dropped

Elements.name: FlattenDecisionResults
Elements.description: Move ApexAction decision output into IP-level variables for DR Load and Response step.

assignments.name: estimatedRate
assignments.comment: Pre-qualification rate estimate based on credit band — not a binding offer

Elements.name: PersistLoanApplication
Elements.description: Calls DR-Load-LoanDecisionLoad to upsert LoanApplication__c with full loan request details + eligibility decision. Uses ExternalId__c for idempotent upsert.

onError.message: Failed to persist loan application. Correlation: %ipCorrelationId%. Error: %error:message%

Elements.name: UpdateLoanAppId
Elements.description: Update loanAppId with the Id returned from the DR Load (in case it was newly created).

Elements.name: ApprovalRoutingGate
Elements.description: Submit to Salesforce approval process only when decision is MANUAL_REVIEW and the loan was successfully persisted. AUTO_APPROVED and DECLINED do not require human approval.

trueElements.name: SubmitForApproval
trueElements.description: Calls WealthManagementCallable.call('calculateLoanEligibility') with the persisted loanAppId to trigger LoanEligibilityService.routeToApproval().

onError.comment: Approval submission failure is non-fatal — record is persisted and advisor can manually submit

Elements.name: NotificationGate
Elements.description: Send advisor notification email for MANUAL_REVIEW decisions, and confirmation email to applicant for all decisions.

trueElements.name: SendApplicantConfirmation
trueElements.description: Calls internal notification service (or Salesforce Messaging) to send applicant confirmation email.

onError.comment: Email failure should never block loan application confirmation

Elements.name: IPResponse
Elements.description: Returns the full eligibility result to the LoanApplication OmniScript. Output keys map to OmniScript EligibilityResult:* context paths used by the three outcome Conditional elements.

globalOnError.comment: Global error defaults to MANUAL_REVIEW so no application is silently dropped. A loan officer receives the case for investigation.

interviewNotes.dualModePurpose: This IP handles two distinct call patterns from the OmniScript: (1) CALCULATE_DTI — called on Step 2 load via autoTrigger:true, executes only steps 1–5 and returns immediately with DTI info; (2) FULL_ELIGIBILITY — called on Step 3 Submit, runs the full pipeline through step 14. This avoids duplicating orchestration logic across two separate IPs.
interviewNotes.earlyExitPattern: Step 5 (EarlyExitForDTIOnlyMode) checks actionMode === 'CALCULATE_DTI' and returns a Response immediately via a trueElement. OmniStudio IP execution stops at a Response element, so steps 6–14 never run in DTI-only mode. This is the IP equivalent of an early return statement.
interviewNotes.apexCallableOrchestration: Steps 3, 6, 8, and 12a all call WealthManagementCallable with different action values. The Callable routes each to the correct Apex service method. This is the OmniStudio → Apex integration pattern — IPs cannot call Apex directly except through Callable or @InvocableMethod.
interviewNotes.creditFetchErrorHandling: Step 6 (FetchCreditScore) uses SetValueAndContinue on error — a Credit Bureau outage causes the score to be null, and step 8 (RunEligibilityDecision) then sets decision = MANUAL_REVIEW (LoanEligibilityService.determineDecision returns DECLINED for null score, so the IP override at step 8 onError catches this and routes to MANUAL_REVIEW instead). Applicant is not falsely declined due to API failure.
interviewNotes.estimatedRateFormula: Step 9 computes a pre-qualification rate estimate inline using a nested ternary expression — EXCELLENT:4.5%, VERY_GOOD:5.25%, GOOD:6.0%, other:7.5%. This is not a binding rate but gives the applicant a real-time indication. In production, this would be a CMDT lookup for configurable rate tiers.
interviewNotes.drLoadPlacement: The DataRaptor Load (step 10) runs after the Callable decision (step 8), not before. This means the LoanApplication__c record is written once with the final decision already populated — no partial write followed by an update. One upsert, final state.
interviewNotes.globalErrorDefaultsToManualReview: The globalOnError returns decision:MANUAL_REVIEW so any unhandled exception routes the application to a human reviewer rather than silently failing. This satisfies the bank's regulatory requirement that no loan application can be dropped without human review.
interviewNotes.correlationIdTracing: ipCorrelationId flows through all error messages, the Response output, and the notification payload. An advisor can take the ID from the LoanApplication__c record and search OmniStudio IP execution logs or Apex debug logs to trace the exact execution path of that specific application.
